dedupe_keys.name: time series measurement data of office building in jakarta indonesia incoming transformer of 20 kv 0 4 kv

description: Abdul Wachid Syamroni and Abduh Aziz Basharah at Indonesia's National Research and Innovation Agency publish measurements from three incoming transformers serving an office building in Jakarta. Each transformer is rated 2 MVA at 20/0.4 kV. Three Excel workbooks contain eight days of measurements from 2016, including three-phase voltage, current, active, reactive and apparent power, power factor and total harmonic distortion. Derived quantities include active-power losses, voltage imbalance and efficiency. The 2022 deposit is free under CC BY 4.0. The description calls the sampling interval minute-scale but does not specify its exact length or the observation dates. These data can calibrate building electrical-load and transformer-loss simulations. One building and a short campaign do not establish representative Jakarta demand. No related catalogue resource explicitly covers this campaign. Measurement calibration and workbook contents were not checked.
